name: Disable TOTP
summary: Disables TOTP for the current authenticated identity and removes enrolled authenticator and recovery-code material.

guards.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and TOTP is enabled for the current durable identity

sourceReferences.note: DisableMfaAsync removes both secure secrets, clears LastMfaDateTimeUtc and LastTotpAcceptedTimeStep, and sets TwoFactorEnabled false.
POST /api/auth/mfadisable exposes the operation for a confirmed user.
